messages.text: The failed probes were blocked only because PowerShell tried to delete OS-temporary files outside the workspace; no application behavior was tested. I’ll capture both streams in memory instead, then make the port in one edit phase, including native ZIP metadata parsing for AES verification rather than depending on a third-party package.

commands.commandLine: $r=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); function RunRef([string[]]$a){$p=[Diagnostics.Process]::new();$p.StartInfo.FileName=$r;$p.StartInfo.UseShellExecute=$false;$p.StartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput=$true;$p.StartInfo.RedirectStandardError=$true;foreach($x in $a){$p.StartInfo.ArgumentList.Add($x)};$p.Start()|Out-Null;$out=$p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();$err=$p.StandardError.ReadToEnd();$p.WaitForExit();"ARGS: $($a -join ' ')`nEXIT:$($p.ExitCode)`nOUT:`n${out}ERR:`n${err}---"}; RunRef @('--help'); RunRef @('--version'); RunRef @(); RunRef @('-i','missing.zip'); RunRef @('-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-w','0'); RunRef @('-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','--minPasswordLen','3','--maxPasswordLen','2')
